convert_decimal_to_binary: convert a decimal integer to its binary representation as an integer using f_gold
test_f_gold_conversion: test the f_gold function against multiple decimal inputs to verify binary conversion correctness
run_transcoder_evaluation: run the transcoder evaluation harness comparing f_filled output against f_gold for decimal to binary
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold function to use Python built-in bin instead of manual division by 2
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which converts decimal numbers to binary using repeated modulo and division
